author: Sp4nKy
quote:
Coming from a pc and always looking for high end 4k gaming these days. What a let down for the ps5 pro version. People who are giving this high praise for graphics obviously have not seen 4k high end gameplay from cyberpunk.

Sure there is a improvement from gta 5 and given the gap it should be but limiting to 30fps. I mean come on atleast 40 fps to frame sync with 120hz with vrr. To give some smoothness to things.

Without spoiling, gameplay is a gta game that has lost the gta feel coming from a long term fan of the series back from the og gta 1 on pc.

Others saying the wokeness has killed it are pretty spot on. Story is a chore and the first gta i have put down without finishing.

Sad to see its come to this for such a successful franchise. Should be copping alot more flack for being overhyped and put out in the state it is in by actual reviewers and streamers like cyberpunk was as this is worse on release.
